templates.name: Non-Disclosure Agreement
templates.description: A mutual or one-way agreement preventing parties from disclosing confidential information shared between them.

templates.name: Employment Contract
templates.description: A formal agreement between an employer and employee setting out the terms and conditions of employment.

templates.name: Service Agreement
templates.description: A contract between a service provider and a client defining the scope, terms, and payment for services rendered.

templates.name: Independent Contractor Agreement
templates.description: An agreement engaging a self-employed individual or entity to perform specific work, clearly distinguishing them from an employee.

templates.name: Residential Lease Agreement
templates.description: A contract between a landlord and tenant setting out the terms for renting a residential property.

templates.name: Letter of Intent
templates.description: A preliminary agreement outlining the key terms of a proposed transaction or partnership before a formal contract is drafted.
